count_rationale: Twice V3 wallet count per agent provides100-wallet local reservoirs; repeated units keep pool size and expected per-entity event exposure constant across partition sizes.12/3/3/2 communities are a controlled synthetic replication design, not a representative regional network.
entity_IDs: Later materialization derives independent128-bit opaque wallet/agent IDs from partition entity streams. Transaction IDs are unique random positive63-bit integers drawn without replacement; no family/time/partition block prefixes. IDs are join/order keys, never input features.
isolation: Wallets and agents disjoint across partitions; no cross-partition edge, history, warm-up, state or ID collision. Units are isolated communities within a partition; no cross-unit W2W or service. Unit ID is private and excluded from X.
scaled_design: Same horizon and unit structure for all partitions; fresh streams and entities. Final same process as development. Independent shift parameters are listed in holdout policy.
status: DESIGN_ONLY; implementation and population evidence pending

warmup.label_storage: Optional evaluator diagnostic stream only; warm-up truth excluded from model training and reported scored prevalence. No y forced to 0.
warmup.selection: Fixed timestamp interval, never label-based discard; all scored rows kept even if baseline-ineligible.
warmup.storage: Separate warmup_observables file per partition with identical event schema, fed before scored transactions; files hash-manifested and kept permanently.
